title: Oxva VPrime Replacement Vape Pods 2ml - 2 Pods
description: The OXVA VPrime Replacement Pods are designed to complement the performance of your OXVA VPrime Pod Kit, delivering exceptional flavour and vapour production thanks to their built-in mesh coils. Each pod has a 2ml e-liquid capacity and comes in three different resistances, allowing you to choose the perfect pod for your preferred vaping style, whether it’s mouth-to-lung (MTL), restricted direct-to-lung (RDTL), or direct-to-lung (DTL) vaping. Each pack contains two replacement pods, and the mesh coil technology ensures consistent heating and excellent flavour with every puff. The top-fill design makes refilling simple and mess-free, while the pods’ leak-resistant construction ensures a clean vaping experience. The 0.2ohm pod is ideal for sub-ohm DTL vaping, providing large clouds and intense flavour when paired with high-VG e-liquids. Best used at higher wattages, this pod is perfect for those who enjoy a bolder, more open draw. The 0.4ohm pod is suited for RDTL vaping, striking a balance between cloud production and flavour. Compatible with 50/50 or high-VG e-liquids, this pod provides a satisfying draw with smooth vapour and rich flavour notes. For those who prefer a tighter, MTL vaping style, the 0.6ohm pod is a great option. It works best with 50/50 e-liquids and nic salts, delivering a more discreet vapour production and a smoother throat hit, making it perfect for vapers looking for a more cigarette-like experience. Pod Details: We recommend paring these pods with the following E_liquid: 0.2ohm (DTL) : Best for high-VG e-liquids, works well at higher wattages, producing large clouds and bold flavour. 0.4ohm (RDTL) : Suitable for both high-VG and 50/50 e-liquids , offering a balanced vape between cloud production and flavour. 0.6ohm (MTL): Best used with 50/50 e-liquids or nic salts for a smooth throat hit and discreet vapour production. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
